description: Non-material amendment to planning permission ref: 2024/01570/FUL granted 21st August 2024 for the 'Erection of a single storey rear extension to the side of the existing back addition; installation of a new window to replace the existing door at lower ground floor level to the rear elevation' to allow amendments to the rear elevation of the lower ground floor extension to include the installation of timber framed double glazed French doors in place of aluminium framed bi-folding doors to the rear of kitchen, the installation of a timber framed double glazed single door in place of the window to the rear of bedroom 2 and the omission of parapet to north/ side elevation (revised description).
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - AMEND CONDITION 2 OF PARENT PERMISSION REF 2024/01570/FUL TO READ:

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in complete accordance with the approved plans and drawings listed in this decision notice, other than where those details are altered pursuant to the conditions of this planning permission. 

-  PL101 REV B, PL102 REV B, PL103, PL104, PL105 REV A, PL106 REV C

- Flood Risk Assessment (14/08/2024 (RevA)). 

To ensure full compliance with the planning application hereby approved and to prevent harm arising through deviations from the approved plans.
